summary: Iteration 26 testing complete. All Effects feature requirements verified: Backend APIs return effects as arrays, filter by effects works, admin CRUD accepts effects arrays. Frontend has EffectsMultiSelect component in grower form, admin strain editor, admin add strain, and FilterSidebar. Strain detail modal displays effects as styled tags.
passed_tests: ✅ Backend: GET /api/strains returns effects as array of strings (not comma-separated)
✅ Backend: GET /api/strains?effects=<effect> filters strains containing that effect
✅ Backend: POST /api/strains/admin/create accepts effects as array ['Euphoria', 'Relaxed', 'Creative thinking']
✅ Backend: PUT /api/strains/{id} accepts effects as array and saves correctly
✅ Backend: Grower submissions store effects and convert to array on approval
✅ Frontend: Grower submission form shows EffectsMultiSelect with data-testid='grower-effects-select'
✅ Frontend: EffectsMultiSelect dropdown shows 79 effects organized by category (MOOD & EMOTION, MENTAL & COGNITIVE, BODY & PHYSICAL, etc.)
✅ Frontend: EffectsMultiSelect has search functionality to filter effects
✅ Frontend: Catalog FilterSidebar has Effects section with data-testid='filter-effects'
✅ Frontend: Effects filter is a <select> dropdown that adds effect tags as filters
✅ Frontend: Selected effects display as removable gold tags in filter sidebar
✅ Frontend: Strain detail modal shows effects as styled tags with gold background
✅ Frontend: Admin panel shows Strain Management with 32 strains and + ADD NEW STRAIN button
✅ Frontend: Admin Add Strain form has EffectsMultiSelect (data-testid='add-strain-effects')
✅ Frontend: Admin Edit Strain form has EffectsMultiSelect (data-testid='edit-strain-effects')

success_rate.frontend: 100% (All Effects feature UI components verified via Playwright)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 26 verified all Effects feature requirements: 1) Backend API returns effects as arrays (List[str]) in Strain model. 2) Effects filter query param uses MongoDB $all operator. 3) Frontend EFFECTS_LIST constant at line 70 contains 79 effects organized in 9 categories. 4) EffectsMultiSelect component at line 84 supports max 8 selections with search. 5) Grower submission form sends effects as comma-separated string (FormData limitation), backend converts to array on approval. 6) FilterSidebar has effects select dropdown adding effect filter tags. 7) Strain detail modal displays effects as styled gold tags using Array.isArray check with fallback string split. Key data-testids: grower-effects-select, filter-effects, add-strain-effects, edit-strain-effects.
